#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

long long calculate(int n, int mod) {
    if (n <= 3) {
        return 0;
    }
    long long last_result = 17;
    long long result = 17;
    int max_size = (n - 1) * (n - 2) / 2 + 1;
    int flip = 1;
    vector<vector<long long>> dp_table(2, vector<long long>(max_size + 1, 0));
    dp_table[0][0] = 1;
    dp_table[0][1] = 2;
    dp_table[0][2] = 2;
    dp_table[0][3] = 1;
    for (int m = 4; m < n; ++m) {
        int total_pairs = m * (m - 1) / 2;
        result = (long long)(m + 1) * last_result;
        long long partial_sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            partial_sum += dp_table[flip ^ 1][i];
            partial_sum %= mod;
            dp_table[flip][i] = partial_sum;
        }
        for (int i = m; i <= total_pairs / 2; ++i) {
            partial_sum += dp_table[flip ^ 1][i];
            partial_sum -= dp_table[flip ^ 1][i - m];
            partial_sum %= mod;
            if (partial_sum < 0) partial_sum += mod;
            dp_table[flip][i] = partial_sum;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= total_pairs / 2; ++i) {
            dp_table[flip][total_pairs - i] = dp_table[flip][i];
        }
        long long total_acc = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < total_pairs; ++i) {
            long long temp_sum = 0;
            int start_j = max(1, -total_pairs + i + m + 2);
            for (int j = start_j; j <= m; ++j) {
                int index = m + 2 - j + i;
                if (index >= 0 && index <= max_size) {
                    temp_sum += j * dp_table[flip][index];
                }
            }
            total_acc += dp_table[flip][i];
            total_acc %= mod;
            temp_sum %= mod;
            result += temp_sum * total_acc;
            result %= mod;
        }
        last_result = result;
        flip ^= 1;
    }
    return result % mod;
}

int main() {
    int n, mod;
    cin >> n >> mod;
    cout << calculate(n, mod) << "\n";
    return 0;
}
